summary: The proposed change moves the logic for determining whether to use the required attribute from ClearableFileInput to FileInput, which aligns with the issue description. However, it may introduce behavioral regression risk if there are specific use cases where ClearableFileInput needs different behavior.

issues.description: Moving the logic from ClearableFileInput to FileInput might unintentionally affect other subclasses of FileInput or use cases where ClearableFileInput behaves differently.
